name: Acoustic & Singer-Songwriter
author: Flubsound (Flubes & Claude)
description: For acoustic guitar, piano and voice: folk, singer-songwriter and unplugged recordings. Warmth at 35 % adds body to guitar and voice (about +1 dB at 125-250 Hz) with a trace of tube colour (well under 0.1 % distortion), a 10 kHz shelf keeps the strings' detail and air from dulling, and a gentle presence lift near 2.8 kHz helps a voice that is not already forward. A de-esser at 6.5 kHz catches sharp sibilance. Nothing is compressed or pushed louder, and light crossfeed makes it comfortable on headphones.
